signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Takes about a minute. You'll set up your profile after.
signup.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with at least one letter and one digit.
signup.successBody: We sent a verification link to your email. Click the link to activate your account.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email a link to the address on file. The link expires in 30 minutes.
forgotPassword.successDescription: If an account exists for that email, we sent a reset link. The link expires in 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose something you can remember.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been reset. Continue to login.
resetPassword.expiredBody: Reset links are valid for 30 minutes and one use. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.requestNewSubtitle: Confirm the email — we'll send a fresh reset link.
resetPassword.newLinkSentDescription: Check your email for a new reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.

verifyEmail.title: Confirming your identity.
verifyEmail.verifyingBody: Please wait while we verify your email address.
verifyEmail.successDescription: Your email has been confirmed. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This verification link is missing or invalid.

errors.oauthConflict: An account with this email already exists. Please sign in with your email and password.
errors.rateLimitExceeded: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.accountLocked: Too many failed login attempts. Please try again later.
